From the research shelf (docs.saltmarsh.example/limits, read 2026-08-21):

- Hosted runner job: cancelled after 6 hours.
- Whole pipeline run: cancelled after 72 hours.
- Queued more than 24 hours: dropped.
- Self-hosted runner: no job time limit.

So your ~7 hour nightly job will be killed on a hosted runner. You'd need a self-hosted runner (no job limit; the 72h pipeline cap still applies per run), or split the work into under-6-hour jobs.

One caveat: that note is from August 2026 — worth a quick check against the current docs before you build on it.
